{{Quote|By the brazen claws of the great octowhale! What is happening to the ''sky''?|Senator Tikkes|<ref name="SW31" />}}
The '''octowhale''' was a type of creature with [[Claw/Legends|claws]]. While on a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Unidentified jungle world (Kamdon system)|planet]],<ref name="SW31" /> in [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The events of [[Star Wars (1998) 31|''Star Wars'' (1998) 31]] take place thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes began in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]] mentioned the great creature's brazen claws after witnessing a [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor shower]] bombard the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface sooner than he expected.<ref name="SW31" />

==Behind the scenes==
The octowhale was mentioned in the [[Star Wars (1998) 31|thirty-first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' comic series. The comic was written by [[Timothy Truman]]<ref name="SW31" /> and published on [[June 27]], [[2001]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-060/Star-Wars-31The-Hunt-for-Aurra-Sing-Part-4-of-4|text=Star Wars #31 The Hunt for Aurra Sing (Part 4 of 4)}}</ref>
